dct_description_sm:
Includes schools from the Greater Victoria School District 61, and private schools.  This dataset is unofficial, it is just used for representation in our own mapping and is rarely updated.  Please refer to the Greater Victoria School District and Private Schools for official, up to date information.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
schema_provider_s: City of Victoria Open Data Portal
